name: ryu.hook-observers
description: A worked reference for the turn-hook events Ryu can fire: five observer hooks watching subagent-stop, session-end, notification, workflow-run-failed, and a third-party app event (`com.ryu.meetings#meeting.ended`), each returning a harmless note. Nothing in Core knows this plugin exists — copy the directory as the starting point for your own event-driven plugin.
